Class BankAccountRegistrationController

public without sharing class BankAccountRegistrationController

Apex controller for the Visualforce page BankAccountRegistration. Loads the pending BankAccount__c row identified by the code URL parameter, prefills the form with the venue's address and contact emails, validates the routing/account-number inputs, and registers the recipient with Mercury via MercuryService. On a hard service failure the customer is still shown the confirmation page; the failure is logged via ErrorLog__c for internal follow-up.

Constructors

public BankAccountRegistrationController()

Initializes the controller from the page parameters. Reads the code parameter, loads the matching BankAccount__c, and prefills bankAccount with address (own address if populated, otherwise the venue's billing address) and contact emails. Sets errorCode/errorMessage when the code is missing, invalid, or refers to a record not in waiting status.

Methods

public PageReference finish()

Returns a PageReference to either the endURL parameter supplied to the page or, when blank, the URL configured in MERCURY_REGISTRATION_CTRL_RETURN_URL.

Returns:
    PageReference: target page to redirect the customer to after confirmation

public PageReference register()

Validates the form inputs and registers the recipient with Mercury. On success, updates the placeholder BankAccount__c with the service-issued identifiers and toggles confirmationPage to render the confirmation view. On a recognized routing/account-number error the form is re-rendered with a targeted message; on any other service failure the placeholder is marked with HasErrors__c=true, an ErrorLog__c entry is created, and the confirmation page is still shown so the customer is not blocked.

Returns:
    PageReference: always null (re-renders the current page)

public void setBankAccountType()

No-op setter bound to the account-type radio group on the page; the accountType property is updated directly by the framework, but the page references this method as the change handler.
